description: Mikko Kouhia and Timo Laukkanen at Aalto University publish the dh-objectives research code for comparing goals in district-heating network design. The Zenodo description identifies a planning tool that evaluates how alternative design objectives affect the resulting networks. Version 1.0.0 is archived as a ZIP in May 2018 and links the corresponding GitLab release. Access is free under MIT. The short metadata do not specify the solver, implementation language, input tables, objective formulations, example geography or planning horizon. Coverage must therefore be established from the release documentation before applying the code. Its stated optimisation purpose makes it a candidate for comparing district-heating design assumptions within infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. No code was downloaded or run, and current maintenance is unknown.
inputs: District-heating planning objectives and network assumptions; schema not stated
